description: This file defines the HL7Source class in the org.openmrs.hl7 package, representing a source of HL7 messages with methods for accessing its ID and annotations for auditing.

classes.name: HL7Source
classes.description: Represents a unique source location for HL7 messages within the OpenMRS system. Extends BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata and provides accessors for HL7 source ID.

methods.name: HL7Source
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HL7Source with a specified ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the HL7 source, override from superclass.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the HL7 source, override from superclass.
